pairs.target: mǐlā zhī dāying kàn tú , tǎ wéi què yǐjīng tì tā liú hǎo le zuòwèi .
pairs.english: Mira had only agreed to look at the drawing, but Tavi had already saved her a seat.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉只答应看图，塔维却已经替她留好了座位。

pairs.target: tā zhàn zài dōng wū ménkǒu , kàn le yìyǎn zhuōbiān de sān bǎ yǐzi , méiyǒu lìjí zuòxià .
pairs.english: Standing in the east-room doorway, she glanced at the three chairs by the table and didn't sit down immediately.
pairs.hanzi: 她站在东屋门口，看了一眼桌边的三把椅子，没有立即坐下。

pairs.target: " nǐ gēn shuí shuō wǒhuì zuò ? " " hái méi gēn ā duō shuō . " " biérén ne ? "
pairs.english: “Who did you tell I'd do it?” “I haven't told Ado yet.” “Anyone else?”
pairs.hanzi:
“你跟谁说我会做？”
“还没跟阿多说。”
“别人呢？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhè cái tīng chū wèntí .
pairs.english: Only then did Tavi hear the problem.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这才听出问题。

pairs.target: tā gēn sū yǐ shuō mǐlā huì bāng zhe bǎ jiàzi gǎi hǎo , yě gēn pà wò shuō guò , shì dēng de shíhòu lái zǒu liǎngquān jiù xíng .
pairs.english: He'd told Suyi that Mira would help improve the frame, and Pavo that all he'd need to do at the lamp trial was walk a few circuits.
pairs.hanzi: 他跟苏苡说米拉会帮着把架子改好，也跟帕沃说过，试灯的时候来走两圈就行。

pairs.target: tā méi xiǎng guò nàjùhuà tīng qǐlái xiàng yǐjīng fēn hǎo le huó .
pairs.english: He hadn't thought it sounded like he'd already assigned the work.
pairs.hanzi: 他没想过那句话听起来像已经分好了活。

pairs.target: chángxiū jiéshù hòu de dìsāntiān , dàjiā gè yǒu tuōhuílái de shìqíng .
pairs.english: Three days after the long break ended, everyone had brought back things of their own.
pairs.hanzi: 长休结束后的第三天，大家各有拖回来的事情。

pairs.target: mǐlā de fùqīn gěi le tā liǎngzhāng lùjī tú , tā xiǎng zài xiàcì jìxìn qián nòng míngbái yídào páishuǐgōu wèishénme zhuǎn le wān .
pairs.english: Mira's father had given her two roadbed drawings; before her next letter she wanted to understand why a drainage ditch bent.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉的父亲给了她两张路基图，她想在下次寄信前弄明白一道排水沟为什么转了弯。

pairs.target: sū yǐ yào bǔ yímiàn dēngyǐng yòng de zhǐ píng , pà wò zé shuō , shuí bǎ tā de xié huà dào zhāo rén de zhǐ shàng , tā jiù xiàng shuí shōuqián .
pairs.english: Suyi had a shadow-lamp paper screen to repair; Pavo said he'd charge whoever drew his shoes on a recruiting notice.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡要补一面灯影用的纸屏，帕沃则说，谁把他的鞋画到招人的纸上，他就向谁收钱。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi mànmàn bǎ pángbiān de yǐzi tuīhuíqù .
pairs.english: Tavi slowly pushed the extra chair back.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维慢慢把旁边的椅子推回去。

pairs.target: " nà nǐ xiān kàn . kàn wán yǒukōng zàishuō . "
pairs.english: “Then look first. We can talk if you have time afterwards.”
pairs.hanzi: “那你先看。看完有空再说。”

pairs.target: " kàn wán yě wèibì yǒukōng . " " hǎo . "
pairs.english: “I might not have time afterwards either.” “All right.”
pairs.hanzi:
“看完也未必有空。”
“好。”

pairs.target: mǐlā zhè cái zuòxià . tā yòng zhǐtou yāzhù tú shàng de wàihuán , wèn dēng guà zài nǎér , tuǐ yòu zài nǎér .
pairs.english: Only then did Mira sit. Pressing the outer ring in the drawing, she asked where the lamp hung, and where his leg was.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉这才坐下。她用指头压住图上的外环，问灯挂在哪儿，腿又在哪儿。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi qǔchū yìgēn kuān bùdài , wéi dào zìjǐ yāo shàng , ná mùpiàn bǐ dēng de wèizhì .
pairs.english: Tavi took a broad cloth belt, wrapped it around his waist, and used wood to represent the lamp.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维取出一根宽布带，围到自己腰上，拿木片比灯的位置。

pairs.target: kōng zhe de dìfāng zài zhǐ shàng hěndà , dào le shēnshàng , shǒu yì chuí biàn zhuàng zhe .
pairs.english: The space looked large on paper, but on his body a lowered hand hit it.
pairs.hanzi: 空着的地方在纸上很大，到了身上，手一垂便撞着。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu tì tā chóngxīn huà , zhī bǎ tuǐ zǒudòng shí yào zhàn de dìfāng tiānchéng yídào hú .
pairs.english: She didn't redraw it for him, only added an arc for the space his leg needed in motion.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有替他重新画，只把腿走动时要占的地方添成一道弧。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn zìjǐ de liǎnggè yuánhuán quán luò zài hú lǐ , liǎn yǒudiǎn fārè .
pairs.english: Tavi saw both rings inside the arc and felt his face warm.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见自己的两个圆环全落在弧里，脸有点发热。

pairs.target: " chuán méiyǒu tuǐ . " mǐlā shuō .
pairs.english: “Boats don't have legs,” Mira said.
pairs.hanzi: “船没有腿。”米拉说。

pairs.target: sū yǐ xiào chū shēng , suíjí bǎ zìjǐ de zhǐ píng tuōkāi , gěi tā ràngchū yíkuài néng fàngdàzhǐ de zhuōmiàn .
pairs.english: Suyi laughed aloud, then dragged her paper screen aside to make room for a large sheet on the table.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡笑出声，随即把自己的纸屏拖开，给他让出一块能放大纸的桌面。

pairs.target: zhè búshì jiè xìng kè .
pairs.english: This wasn't an exchange class.
pairs.hanzi: 这不是借性课。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī zhǔn tāmen zài zhíshǒu shíchén shǐyòng kào mén de gōngzuòtái , fèiliào xiāng lǐ biāo guò kěyòng de báopiàn yě néng lǐng ;
pairs.english: Instructor Vey allowed the workbench by the door during supervised hours, and marked usable offcuts from the scrap box;
pairs.hanzi: 维老师准他们在值守时辰使用靠门的工作台，废料箱里标过可用的薄片也能领；

pairs.target: gōngjù yòng wán guīwèi , diǎnhuǒ yào lìng děng jiǎnchá .
pairs.english: but tools must be put away, and lighting anything required a separate inspection.
pairs.hanzi: 工具用完归位，点火要另等检查。

pairs.target: běi gōng fāng hái méiyǒu huīfù shàngkè , dōng wū de tōngdào bùnéng bèi tāmen zhàn zhù .
pairs.english: The north workshop hadn't reopened for classes, and they mustn't block the east-room passage.
pairs.hanzi: 北工坊还没有恢复上课，东屋的通道不能被他们占住。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ tú zhuǎn le gè fāngxiàng , búzài zhàochāo zhōu shàng de yuánhuán .
pairs.english: Tavi turned the drawing, no longer copying the boat's rings.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把图转了个方向，不再照抄舟上的圆环。

pairs.target: tā yào de búshì yìzhǎn kěyǐ suíbiàn fānzhuǎn de dēng , érshì ràng ā duō bào zhe dōngxī shí , dēng zànshí yǒu dìfāng dài zhe .
pairs.english: He didn't need a lamp that could turn any which way, but somewhere to put it while Ado carried things.
pairs.hanzi: 他要的不是一盏可以随便翻转的灯，而是让阿多抱着东西时，灯暂时有地方待着。

pairs.target: ruò gùdìng zài xiōngqián , mùliào huì dǎng ; ruò zài yāo cè , jiù dé lí yīfu hé tuǐ yuǎn xiē ,
pairs.english: Fixed at the chest, timber would block it; at the waist it must clear clothes and legs,
pairs.hanzi: 若固定在胸前，木料会挡；若在腰侧，就得离衣服和腿远些，

pairs.target: hái bùnéng shēn dé xiàng gēn shùzhī , jiàn mén jiù zhuàng .
pairs.english: without sticking out like a branch that hit every door.
pairs.hanzi: 还不能伸得像根树枝，见门就撞。

pairs.target: pà wò cóng zìjǐ de bāo lǐ chě chū yìzhī jiù bùdài , guà zài bùdài shàng .
pairs.english: Pavo pulled an old cloth bag from his own bag and hung it on the belt.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃从自己的包里扯出一只旧布袋，挂在布带上。

pairs.target: dài lǐ sāi zhe juǎn qǐlái de yīfu , chàbùduō zhàn le yìzhǎndēng de wèizhì .
pairs.english: Rolled clothes filled it, taking roughly as much space as a lamp.
pairs.hanzi: 袋里塞着卷起来的衣服，差不多占了一盏灯的位置。

pairs.target: tā zǒu dào ménbiān , cèshēn jǐguòqù , bùdài cā shàng ménkuàng , zhuǎn le bànquān .
pairs.english: He went to the door and squeezed sideways through; the bag scraped the frame and turned halfway round.
pairs.hanzi: 他走到门边，侧身挤过去，布袋擦上门框，转了半圈。

pairs.target: " kàn , dēng qù zhàoqiáng le . "
pairs.english: “Look, now the lamp lights the wall.”
pairs.hanzi: “看，灯去照墙了。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi nábǐ de shǒu tíngzhù .
pairs.english: Tavi's pen stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维拿笔的手停住。

pairs.target: tā xiānqián yìzhí dīng zhe dēngzhǎn wāi bu wāi , jìng méi xiǎng guò zhěnggè jiàzi huì yìqǐ zhuǎn .
pairs.english: He'd been watching whether the oil cup tilted, never considering that the whole frame could turn.
pairs.hanzi: 他先前一直盯着灯盏歪不歪，竟没想过整个架子会一起转。

pairs.target: tāmen gǎiyòng liǎnggè xiānggé de guàdiǎn , bǎ bùdài tiē zài yìxiǎokuài mùbǎn wàicè .
pairs.english: They switched to two spaced hanging points, with the bag against the outside of a small board.
pairs.hanzi: 他们改用两个相隔的挂点，把布袋贴在一小块木板外侧。

pairs.target: mùbǎn hé yīfu zhījiān liúkōng , qiánmiàn yòu jiā le zhǐ zuò de zhào .
pairs.english: They left a gap between board and clothes and added a paper hood at the front.
pairs.hanzi: 木板和衣服之间留空，前面又加了纸做的罩。

pairs.target: zhòngliàng yòng zhuāng zhe gān shā de xiǎodài dàitì yóuzhǎn , fān dǎoyěbúhuì shī yí dì .
pairs.english: A small dry-sand bag replaced the oil cup's weight, so tipping it wouldn't soak the floor.
pairs.hanzi: 重量用装着干沙的小袋代替油盏，翻倒也不会湿一地。

pairs.target: pà wò bào qǐ kōng mùxiāng , zài wūlǐ zǒu le yígè láihuí , zhōngyú méiyǒu zài zhuǎn zhe jìnmén .
pairs.english: Carrying an empty crate, Pavo walked the room and back; at last he entered without the bag spinning.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃抱起空木箱，在屋里走了一个来回，终于没有再转着进门。

pairs.target: dé mǎ xiàkè lái ná chǐ , kànjiàn zhuōshàng shēnchū qù de yì jié mùpiàn , shuō tā xiàng zhī duàn chì de niǎo .
pairs.english: Dema came for a ruler after class, saw the projecting wood and said it looked like a bird with a broken wing.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛下课来拿尺，看见桌上伸出去的一截木片，说它像只断翅的鸟。

pairs.target: " nǐ yě lái bāngmáng ? " tǎ wéi wèn wán jiù yǒudiǎn hòuhuǐ .
pairs.english: “Are you helping too?” Tavi regretted asking almost immediately.
pairs.hanzi: “你也来帮忙？”塔维问完就有点后悔。

pairs.target: " wǒ lái ná chǐ . "
pairs.english: “I came for a ruler.”
pairs.hanzi: “我来拿尺。”

pairs.target: tā ná qǐ chǐ , yòu kàn le kàn mùbǎn biānyuán , shuō zìjǐ míngtiān kěyǐ tì tā cuò zhè yíduàn máocì , biéde méi shíjiān .
pairs.english: She picked up the ruler, looked at the board's edge, and offered to file that rough section tomorrow, but had no time for more.
pairs.hanzi: 她拿起尺，又看了看木板边缘，说自己明天可以替他锉这一段毛刺，别的没时间。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎntóu , bǎ nà yìxiǎo duàn quān chūlái , méiyǒu bǎ tā de míngzì xiě dào zhěngzhāng tú shàng .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded and circled that little section without putting her name on the whole drawing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点头，把那一小段圈出来，没有把她的名字写到整张图上。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ zìjǐ de lùjī tú shōu hǎo zhǔnbèi zǒu .
pairs.english: Mira packed her roadbed drawings to leave.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把自己的路基图收好准备走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō xièxiè , tā bǎibǎishǒu , ràng tā zhēn zuòhǎo hòu jìde gěi ā duō shì ,
pairs.english: Tavi thanked her; she waved and told him to have Ado try it once it really worked,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说谢谢，她摆摆手，让他真做好后记得给阿多试，

pairs.target: bié ràng sìgè xuéshēng tì yígè gànhuó de rén cāi wán yíqiè .
pairs.english: not let four students guess everything for a working man.
pairs.hanzi: 别让四个学生替一个干活的人猜完一切。

pairs.target: wǎnfàn qián , tā bǎ zhǐyàng guà zài qiángshàng de mù gōu shàng , xiàng hòutuì le liǎngbù .
pairs.english: Before supper he hung the paper mock-up on a wall peg and stepped back.
pairs.hanzi: 晚饭前，他把纸样挂在墙上的木钩上，向后退了两步。

pairs.target: tā bù hǎokàn , liǎnggè guàdiǎn xiàng jiānbǎng , xiàmiàn tuō zhe yìzhī gǔgǔde shādài .
pairs.english: It was ugly: two hanging points like shoulders, a bulging sandbag below.
pairs.hanzi: 它不好看，两个挂点像肩膀，下面拖着一只鼓鼓的沙袋。

pairs.target: sū yǐ gěi zhǐ zhào jiǎn le yígè cháo xià de kǒu , zhàn zài pángbiān kàn le yíhuìer , wèn tā shénme shíhòu shì .
pairs.english: Suyi cut a downward opening in the paper hood, studied it a while, and asked when he'd test it.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡给纸罩剪了一个朝下的口，站在旁边看了一会儿，问他什么时候试。

pairs.target: " děng jiǎnchá guò , tiānàn yìdiǎn de shíhòu . "
pairs.english: “After inspection, when it's a little darker.”
pairs.hanzi: “等检查过，天暗一点的时候。”

pairs.target: tā yuánběn xiǎng zài jiā yíjù " kěndìng xíng ", huàdàozuǐbiān , gǎichéng le " nǐ yàoshi yǒukōng , jiù lái ".
pairs.english: He'd meant to add “It'll definitely work,” but changed it to “Come if you're free.”
pairs.hanzi: 他原本想再加一句“肯定行”，话到嘴边，改成了“你要是有空，就来”。

pairs.target: sū yǐ dāying le . wàimiàn de zhōng qiāoqǐlái , pà wò zài zǒuláng lǐ cuī fàn .
pairs.english: Suyi agreed. The bell outside rang, and Pavo called from the corridor for supper.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡答应了。外面的钟敲起来，帕沃在走廊里催饭。

alignment.english: called from the corridor for supper

pairs.target: tǎ wéi guān hǎo gōngjù chōutì , zhuī chūqù shí cái fāxiàn bùdài hái wéi zài yāo shàng , kōngkòng dì tuō zhe liǎnggēn shéng tóu .
pairs.english: Tavi shut the tool drawer; rushing out, he discovered the belt still around his waist, two empty ties trailing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维关好工具抽屉，追出去时才发现布带还围在腰上，空空地拖着两根绳头。
